scoring_justification: Recompute stable rotational frequencies and oscillation amplitude from the submitted CSV time series, compare with paper values (tolerance ±25% for frequencies, ±0.5 nm for amplitude) ensuring high reproduction yet robust to stochastic MD variation.

outputs.description: Time series of rotational frequencies and inner-rotor z-position from the MD simulations. The checker recomputes stable rotational frequencies and oscillation trends.

output_contract.notes: The time series must cover the full 8000 ps for each simulated condition. The checker will compute the stable rotational frequency of the mid-rotor from the last 1000 ps and verify the temperature dependence and the oscillation amplitude.

hidden_assets.purpose: Target rotational frequencies (GHz) and oscillation amplitude (nm) from paper figures.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Values derived from paper figures: Fig 2a shows ~133 GHz at 400K for various schemes; Fig 3a shows for 4LR ~70 GHz at 200K and ~133 GHz at 250-350K; Fig 4a shows monotonic increase for 1LR; text states oscillation amplitude ~1.5 nm.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read from figures and text; frequencies approximate; tolerances set to ±25% relative for frequencies and ±0.5 nm absolute for amplitude.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported quantitative results; they are not fabricated but serve as reference for reproduction check.
